messages:
marta: Heads-up — proposing new dashboard panels for request-id rollups + trace-sampling visibility. Want runtime/infra + console UX input before I open the RFC. tl;dr: per-route rollup of sampled vs unsampled requests, sampled-span counts distribution, and sample-rate-aware p50/p95 latency.
zach: Sounds reasonable. A couple questions: do we expect per-request indexing (high-cardinality) or strictly aggregated counters? also which header are we using for request IDs? we currently see both `x-request-id` and `x-redwood-id` in the wild.
liam: prefer aggregated counters keyed by route/service + sample_decision to avoid exploding cardinality. e.g., emit `rwd.requests.count{route,env,sampled=0|1}` and `rwd.requests.latency_ms{route,env,pctile}`. dashboards can roll those up per team or model.
anita: from Console side we also want rollout UX hooks: a sample-rate slider, expected sampling % and estimated cost delta when toggling between rates. Can we provide a simple cost formula so product can mock the UI?
sre-bot: Note: historical backing-store retention for detailed traces is 30d; aggregated metrics are cheaper. Creating a dashboard request ticket now (#6213).
zach: Proposal for headers/trace tags: normalize on `x-redwood-request-id` (fallback to `x-request-id`) and add `x-redwood-sampled: 0|1` for early decision. Runtime should also emit a tag `sample_decision=runtime` vs `sample_decision=downstream` if sampling is forced by upstream.
liam: please also include a `route_id` tag not the raw path. we already hash paths to route IDs in the router — use that to keep cardinality stable. example metric names:
```
rwd.request.count route_id=R42 env=prod sampled=1
rwd.sampled_spans.count route_id=R42 span_bin=1..10
rwd.request.latency_ms.p95 route_id=R42 sampled=1
```
zach: telemetry emit example (python):
```
emit_metric("rwd.trace.decision", 1, tags={"route_id": route_id, "sampled":"1"})
log.info(f"req {req_id} sample={sampled} spans={span_count}")
```
anita: UX asks: when sampling is low we should surface 'insufficient trace coverage' on the panel and link to a runbook. Also show sampled fraction line so folks know when a p95 is mostly from sampled requests.
marta: suggested defaults: initial sample_rate = 0.05 for prod, emit `rwd.trace.sample_rate` as gauge per route, and `rwd.sampled_spans.histogram` for span-count distribution. Also include `sample_source` tag to tell whether it was sampled by runtime, model, or uplink.
zach: low-overhead implementation plan: emit 2 counters per request (requests.count total, requests.count sampled) + sampled spans histogram. runtime will set sampled header early in pipeline so all downstream services can tag logs/metrics. will avoid per-request event exports unless `sampled=1`.
liam: console panels we want:
- stacked area: sampled vs unsampled requests per minute (by route)
- histogram: sampled_span_counts (buckets 0..1,2..5,5..10,10+)
- p50/p95 latency lines for sampled and all requests (side-by-side)
- heatmap: sample_rate by region/cluster
Also add a link to trace explorer filtered by `route_id` + `sampled=1`.
anita: questionnaire for billing estimate: expected sampled_qps * avg_span_bytes * retention_days * cost_per_GB. can you supply ballpark numbers so design can show cost slider? small example would be helpful.
marta: quick ballpark: if prod route ~200rps and sample_rate 0.05 => sampled_qps=10; avg trace ~50KB => ~0.5GB/day for that route; multiply by retention and migration factor. we'll put a calc table in the RFC.
zach: implementation asks from runtime team: -- emit `rwd.requests.count` (tagged), `rwd.requests.sampled_count`, `rwd.sampled_spans.histogram`, and `rwd.trace.decision` event for sampled traces only. also add header normalization middleware for `x-redwood-request-id` and `x-redwood-sampled`.
liam: console follow-ups: will mock panels, add sample-rate slider (0-100%) and cost estimate widget. need metric names and tag keys by EOD Friday to prototype.
marta: action items: 1) I'll open RFC PR with metric list + JSON panels draft. 2) @zach please add header normalization + emit counters behind feature-flag. 3) @liam start panel mockups once metric names are finalized. target: RFC + protos in one week. thanks all :memo: :eyes:
deploy-bot: new rfc branch created: `rfc/trace-sampling-dashboard` by marta at sha abc123.
zach: :+1: will start a branch for runtime changes. we may need a quick small change to the router to tag `route_id` earlier.
liam: :raised_hands: I'll slot a design pass on Monday and link sketches in the RFC.
